harness_hardening_delivered: Foreground identity from the uiautomator package; DOM taps are refused while a native window covers the app and fail closed when the foreground cannot be verified (the recorded failure had a mounted Home WebView behind com.google.android.documentsui while mCurrentFocus was null).
Bounded, re-verified KEYCODE_BACK cleanup between cases; a case blocked by a leftover native window reports BLOCKED_PREVIOUS_CASE_NATIVE_WINDOW instead of tapping behind it.
State-driven chooser walk with settled-geometry taps (the recorded mid-animation drawer tap had landed on the wrong row) and exact 'Downloads' vs 'Download' disambiguation.
MediaProjection consent decided from the live hierarchy only, opening the API 35 capture-mode selector before confirming, and never matching the app name from a dialog title.
WebView session recovery so a dead renderer cannot cascade into later cases, plus an independent on-device fixture check so a staging failure is never reported as a navigation failure.

superseded_findings.claim: The failed run 39196654875 shows a mid-run emulator reboot (logcat "beginning of kernel")
superseded_findings.correction: WITHDRAWN. Both the green and the failed artifact contain exactly one "beginning of kernel" line; it is the normal logcat buffer header at boot, not a reboot marker. No reboot is evidenced.

superseded_findings.claim: The startup message "Unable to connect to adb daemon on port: 5037" indicates the failing run lost its adb daemon
superseded_findings.correction: CORRECTED. That message appears once in BOTH runs at emulator startup (green 03:42:02, failed 03:57:50) and is a benign startup race. The failed run's device loss happened later, during the harness phase.

NOT ESTABLISHED. The reproducible, evidence-backed defect is in the harness: the WebView renderer died right after the SAF chooser returned (runs 39188659686 and 39196654875) and the harness had no bounded transport recovery and no session precondition, so case 3 failed with a raw null-handle TypeError. Fixed in this change; no cause for the renderer death itself is asserted.
